fm.title: Objectives constraints
fm.description: Formal verification objectives and input constraints (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Constrain input ranges for formal verification — use for defining valid operating conditions that the design verifier assumes hold during analysis
Specify a property to be formally proven — use for defining safety or correctness assertions that must hold under all valid input conditions
Constrain signals during test generation — use for guiding automatic test vector generation to focus on specific operating regions
Specify a coverage target for test generation — use for directing automatic test generation to achieve specific signal conditions or code paths

fm.title: Temporal operators
fm.description: Temporal logic operators for time-based properties (3 blocks)

rows.intent: Detect when a Boolean condition has been true for N consecutive steps — use for building temporal assertions that require sustained conditions
Extend a Boolean pulse by N time steps — use for holding a trigger active longer when building temporal verification logic
Assert that if P occurs, then Q must follow within N steps — use for bounded response time verification in safety-critical temporal properties
Example models demonstrating property specifications — use as reference for learning how to write formal verification properties
Example models demonstrating temporal property specifications — use as reference for writing time-based formal verification properties
Logical implication operator for verification — use for specifying if-then relationships between conditions in formal property definitions
Container for verification logic excluded from code generation — use for grouping assertions and proof objectives without affecting production code
